about: Frankivsk and the Carpathians: new builds and mountain houses

Ivano-Frankivsk is one of the Ukrainian cities with the most active construction of new housing: many apartments are bought in new builds without finishing. The historic Austrian centre is compact, and beyond the city lie the Carpathian foothills and mountains with chalets, guest houses and cottages.

Our Hoda Estate is a design project for a 180 m² country house in the Carpathians: layout, 3D visualisations, natural materials and built-in furniture. We bring that experience — combining cosiness, mountain views and practicality — to projects in and around Frankivsk.

For new-build apartments in Frankivsk — a layout for the family, a kitchen-living room, walk-in wardrobes. For mountain houses — wood, stone, a fireplace, large windows onto the view and practical utility zones for skis and boots. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate new-build flats from shell condition and houses. In the Carpathians we build log, timber-frame and masonry houses designed for snow loads and slopes, planning the site layout and machinery access in advance; for guest complexes see [turnkey holiday resort](/en/resort-design).

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
